summary: Worse than national, not 'more relaxed': the state's Islamic religious department detained a 25-year-old man dressed and behaving like a woman while he was doing a TikTok livestream in Banda Hilir in the early hours — a state religious agency acting against public gender expression as such, in a state whose tourism brand is heritage-city strolling (the Peranakan heritage core). The national framework applies unchanged here: same-sex conduct criminalised with up to 20 years and whipping, no legal gender recognition, enforcement routed through state religious-offence laws. Scored relative to the national score (0.16) for Malaysia.
